outline: This course provides the principal concepts and fundamental theories of thermodynamics and will cover the basic laws of thermodynamics, the energy analysis in closed systems, the energy interactions between system and environment, and the entropy analysis.
schedule:
週次   單元主題
1. Introduction to Thermodynamics
2-3. Basic concepts and definitions
4-5. Properties of a pure substance
6-7 First law of Thermodynamics
8. Energy analysis of closed systems
9. Midterm Exam
10. Energy analysis of closed systems
11-12. Mass and energy analysis of control volumes
13-14 Second Law of Thermodynamics
15-17. Entropy
18. Final Exam
